required: accepted 02-code-index (function spans from methods/ts_functions; CPG and IR generation bindings)

applicability: optional bounded semantic recall after accepted lexical and structural producers

container_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the container (semantic recall embedding).
container_timeout_seconds.scale: Grows with function count; ~3 KB of vectors per row (768 float32), CPU embedding.

container_memory_bytes.description: Memory limit for the container (semantic recall embedding).
container_memory_bytes.scale: Grows with function count; ~3 KB of vectors per row (768 float32), CPU embedding.

container_cpu_millis.description: CPU quota (1000 = one core) (semantic recall embedding).
container_cpu_millis.scale: Grows with function count; ~3 KB of vectors per row (768 float32), CPU embedding.

container_pids.scale: Grows with function count; ~3 KB of vectors per row (768 float32), CPU embedding.

container_tmpfs_bytes.description: Size of the in-memory /tmp (semantic recall embedding).
container_tmpfs_bytes.scale: Grows with function count; ~3 KB of vectors per row (768 float32), CPU embedding.

container_stdout_limit_bytes.description: Captured stdout; beyond this the log is truncated (semantic recall embedding).
container_stdout_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with function count; ~3 KB of vectors per row (768 float32), CPU embedding.

container_stderr_limit_bytes.description: Captured stderr; beyond this the log is truncated (semantic recall embedding).
container_stderr_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with function count; ~3 KB of vectors per row (768 float32), CPU embedding.

image_id.description: Pinned image whose system python3 carries lancedb and fastembed and runs semantic_index_build.py (mounted, not copied).

batch_size.description: Chunks per embedding batch; ONNX pads a batch to its longest chunk, so keep it small.
batch_size.scale: Legacy runs OOMed at 64 with 27K-char chunks; chunks are now capped at 4000 chars.

max_file_bytes.description: Largest source file read for chunks; larger files are file-too-large gaps.
